environment.description: Kubernetes 1.27 cluster on EKS with default namespace. Pod runs as container image built with CGO_ENABLED=1. Deployment uses hostPath volume mount at /var/run/kafka-buffers for shared state. Container runs with privileged: true securityContext to access host memory mappings for performance optimization. No PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforcement. RBAC allows the service account to read secrets cluster-wide.
